humanOnlyPackages.@stackframe/init-stack: No @hexclave equivalent on npm. The CLI is now `hexclave` in @hexclave/cli (guide L49).

identifiers.source: guide L26 ("all Stack* references are renamed to Hexclave*"), checked against the dist/index.d.ts exports of @stackframe/stack, /react, /js 2.8.108 and @hexclave/next, /react, /js 1.0.136

notes: Passkeys are scoped to the domain where they were registered and are not transferred between the two domains (guide L50). Users who signed in with a passkey register it again.

Env vars were not renamed. The new SDK reads HEXCLAVE_* first, then the old STACK_* names (dist/generated/env.js in @hexclave/next 1.0.136), so the deploy keeps working. Rename them here and in your host together, or leave both (guide L47).
OAuth callback URLs on api.stack-auth.com keep working. Only a provider recreated on the dashboard needs the new callback URL (guide L72 to L76).
